name: openai_probability_baseline_v1
purpose: Optional frozen comparison baseline; never a production forecast model.

input.features: object containing only the frozen temporal feature schema

system_prompt: Estimate the probability that this anonymized online-course enrollment ends in Pass or Distinction. Use only the supplied pre-checkpoint features. Return one JSON object matching the schema. Do not invent evidence.
failure_policy: Fail closed on missing credentials, invalid structured output, incomplete coverage, or cost guard breach. Never substitute predictions.
